methods.label: Extract the common factor, then factor the difference of squares
methods.explanation: First factor out the common factor \(2x\) to obtain \(2x(x^2-4)\). Then use the difference of squares to factor \(x^2-4=(x+2)(x-2)\), continuing until no further factorization is possible.
methods.levelReason: Extracting a common factor and then applying the difference-of-squares identity are grade 8 procedures.
